# riemannhypothesis.dev — Lean 4 Riemann Hypothesis & GRH Upstream Tracker (independent, unofficial)

> Independent tracker of `leanprover-community/riemann-hypothesis`: kernel-export measurements, proof-size history, and PR and verification status. Snapshots are refreshed by a scheduled GitHub Actions run; the dashboard also re-reads the GitHub API in the browser.

## Canonical Pages

- [Project Home](https://riemannhypothesis.dev/): Overview of the Lean Riemann Hypothesis formalization and the community work on its sources.
- [Contributor Guide (Korean)](https://riemannhypothesis.dev/guide.html): Source-linked guide to selecting a contribution, building the project, submitting a pull request, and interpreting measurements. Includes the scope of the material covered and omitted.
- [Live Upstream Tracker](https://riemannhypothesis.dev/tracker.html): Source, proof-size, and verification tracker covering both lineages of `leanprover-community/riemann-hypothesis`: `main`, based on the readable edition of `lsernau/grh-lean`, and the community cleanup of Levent Alpöge's original proof on branch `alpoge` (the original release is on branch `original`).
- [Maintainers, Contributors & Lean Foundations](https://riemannhypothesis.dev/profiles.html): Contributor directory organized by build-time speedups, compute and cache infrastructure, codebase/technical-debt reduction, and merge/triage operations, each tied to a PR or public source.

## Authoritative Technical References

- [Kernel-Cone Specification (`SPEC.md`)](https://github.com/thekeunpie-hash/rh-kernel-backbone/blob/main/SPEC.md): Kernel-cone accounting of the original v0.2.1 release (Alpöge lineage) and the token-count method.
- [Official Upstream Repository (`leanprover-community/riemann-hypothesis`)](https://github.com/leanprover-community/riemann-hypothesis): Upstream Lean 4 proofs of the Riemann Hypothesis and of GRH for Dirichlet L-functions (machine-checked).
- [Tracker Source Repository (`thekeunpie-hash/rh-kernel-backbone`)](https://github.com/thekeunpie-hash/rh-kernel-backbone): Automation scripts, live JSON snapshots, and GitHub Pages source.

## Machine-Readable Snapshots (GitHub Raw)

- `https://raw.githubusercontent.com/thekeunpie-hash/rh-kernel-backbone/main/data/upstream_frontier.json` — Latest measured upstream HEAD, file/line counts, PR queue, and technical-debt counters (`#229`).
- `https://raw.githubusercontent.com/thekeunpie-hash/rh-kernel-backbone/main/data/rh_shrink.json` — Per-commit proof-size series from `rh-shrink.github.io`.
- `https://raw.githubusercontent.com/thekeunpie-hash/rh-kernel-backbone/main/data/verifytask_board.json` — Archived Bohrium Playground benchmark results (original Alpöge tree).
- `https://raw.githubusercontent.com/thekeunpie-hash/rh-kernel-backbone/main/data/community_context.json` — GitHub privileged-action audit and Lean Zulip community context.
